en.answer:
No, they cannot.
The effect of <<22549>> prevents them from activating cards or effects when its controller Tribute Summons a monster, regardless of which side of the field the monster is Tribute Summoned to.

This also applies to the following effects:
● <<18530>>'s ②nd effect
en.question: While the『your opponent cannot activate cards or effects when your monster is Tribute Summoned』effect of my <<22549>> is applying, I Tribute Summon <<11927>> to my opponent's field by Tributing their monsters. Can my opponent activate cards or effects at this time?
en.title: If I Tribute Summon <<11927>> to my opponent's field while <<22549>>'s effect is applying, can my opponent activate effects?

ja.answer:

以下の効果についても同様です。
